cc:Work.dc:title: Frame 50 and its colour-channel arrays
cc:Work.dc:description: TrackID3x3, Yamada et al. (2025), basket_S1T4_pre, frame 50. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ Each scalar channel is displayed as its RGB contribution with the other two components zero. Greyscale, red, green and blue reference ramps share the exact 0-to-255 values. No independent normalisation, enhancement, inference or training.
